A.title: Sand Without Footprints
A.text: The slope is ash over glass; wind erases your trail in a minute. Cut a mark in the rock at every turn. I did not, and I walked past this stone three times.

Y.title: Count the Colossi
Y.text: Colossus pens are east of the gallery. Each beast is as tall as a house and slow to turn. Strike the leg, step back, strike again; they forget you if you stay behind them.

R.title: Half-Buried, Half-Burnt
R.text: A glassmaker's note. Fire does not only cut; if you let the heat come and do not flinch, the skin learns it. It goes hard like a pot in the kiln; stand in the glow and breathe slow.

G.title: Caravan Ledger, Last Line
G.text: Forty camels; Twenty-two men. Salt, glass, two jars of lamp oil. Water: none; we took the wind corridor to save a day; it cost us the rest; do not trust a short road.

M.title: A Scrawl in the Shade
M.text: Do not drink from the Flooded Grotto; it looks clean. My brother drank; he talked to the wall for a night and then he stopped talking. Boil nothing; carry your own.

O.title: Ash Whirl Rule
O.text: When the ash starts to turn, stop; hold your sleeve to your face and wait; it passes in a dozen breaths. If you run, you run into the pits. I saw a man do it.

U.title: Mirage Warning
U.text: If the water shines, it is not water; real water does not shine, it sits. The Ashen Mirage has taken three of ours. It is a room, not a lake; walk through the glare and it ends.

X.title: The Ash King's Court
X.text: They say a king ruled here before the sand. His court is at the bottom, still sitting. One of the old Lodge men saw it; he said they all looked up when he came in; that was all he said.
